name: Begumpet Airport

referencePoint.source: Wikipedia; aviationweather.gov airport database lists 17.453, 78.468 (consistent within rounding)

elevation.discrepancy: aviationweather.gov airport database lists 540 (unit as published there, not independently re-confirmed here). TODO: confirm against an official AIP/NOTAM source before using for anything beyond rough familiarization.

frequenciesMHz.note: Display only, not sourced for operational use. Confirm current published frequencies before any real-world use.

runways.geometryNote: Endpoint coordinates below are the first/last nodes of OpenStreetMap way 28113198 (aeroway=runway, ref=09/27), retrieved via the Overpass API on 2026-10-13 -- a real digitized runway outline, not computed from the reference point. core.mjs's approximateRunwayEnds()/resolveRunwayEnds() still exist as a fallback for an airport that has no such OSM way. Discrepancy, flagged not resolved: the OSM-derived length is ~3103 m, about 4% shorter than the 3230 m published length above -- the community-mapped way may not trace the full paved length exactly.

sources: OpenStreetMap, way/28113198 (runway endpoints), via the Overpass API

circuitAltitude.note: Pilots commonly round the published elevation (~1745 ft, see elevation field) up to 1800 ft for quick mental math. Circuit altitude is flown on the day's QNH, not a fixed pressure setting -- see the live METAR (Phase 3) for current QNH.

liveWeather.note: Fetched live in Phase 3 -- not bundled here since it changes constantly.

limitations: Reference data for ground-based familiarization only. Not for flight planning or navigation. See README for the full disclaimer.
